blocks.html: 26ft Super Panga – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

#2 26ft Super Panga – Private Fishing Charter for 1–3 Guests | From $550 USD

Discover the 26ft Super Panga, a private fishing charter option for couples, friends, and small groups visiting San José del Cabo.

This 26-foot fishing boat offers a practical platform for exploring coastal and offshore fishing opportunities around Los Cabos. Its compact design makes it an appealing alternative to larger sportfishing boats for guests who prefer a smaller, more personal fishing experience.

Depending on the season and ocean conditions, your captain may recommend targeting yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, roosterfish, snapper, or other available species.

Fishing grounds such as Gordo Banks and Iman Bank may be considered when weather and sea conditions allow. The captain determines fishing locations based on safety, seasonal fish activity, and your group's preferences.

Every private charter includes an experienced local captain and crew, fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle. Fishing licenses, bait, food, drinks, transportation, and fish-cleaning services vary depending on the selected trip and must be confirmed before booking.
